goal: Break up the oversized P2P message handler to make peer processing easier to navigate and review
Encapsulate individual message types into dedicated functions to improve code organization
reviewability: Reviewing now is worthwhile because conflicts with master are mechanical and do not affect the logic
agreement: Broad support for breaking up the handler to improve navigation and encapsulation (stickies-v, maflcko)
Verified pure move-only extractions and thread-safety annotations (pseudoramdom, thomasbuilds)
Reimplemented and verified locally with test coverage and color-moved diffs (l0rinc, pablomartin4btc)
Conceded initial objection that separate helpers add caller friction (davidgumberg)
Open suggestion to add a prepare commit removing function prefixes from debug logs (pablomartin4btc)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it is an internal refactoring that improves code organization without changing behavior
It reduces friction for maintainers in peer processing but does not resolve protocol hazards
